sn35.110:0.3: Things That Can Be Clung To
sn35.110:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the things that can be clung to and the clinging.
sn35.110:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, are the things that can be clung to, and what is the clinging?
sn35.110:1.4: The eye, bhikkhus, is a thing that can be clung to;
sn35.110:1.5: the desire and lust for it is the clinging there.
sn35.110:1.6: The ear is a thing that can be clung to …
sn35.110:1.7: The mind is a thing that can be clung to;
sn35.110:1.8: the desire and lust for it is the clinging there.
sn35.110:1.9: These are called the things that can be clung to, and this the clinging.”
